review_scope.text_review: Exhaustive review of all main and remediation step titles, ledes and blocks, including nested visual labels, captions, code walkthroughs and up-next text in the five assembled tile lessons.
review_scope.interaction_review: Reviewed sampled prompts, all offered options or classification excerpts, feedback, and learner workspace text for sampled code exercises. Sampling spans all five tiles and all three interaction types.

method: Independently derived concept boundaries from glossary context.blocked_future_concepts, required facts and the ordered lesson text. The tile plan has no tile-level blocked_future_concepts field, so each concept-specific step was evaluated against its own glossary boundary; recaps summarize already introduced concepts. A later-concept name or supplied fixture setting alone was not treated as a needs-to-understand dependency. No generator reasoning or prior evaluator reports were consulted, and deterministic gates were not rerun.
boundary_observations: JSON request transport and response checks are explicitly part of prediction_schema_validation; they do not require implementing the later online handler.
Container startup, identity/State/log inspection and healthcheck configuration are explicit model_service_readiness facts, not leakage from later deployment concepts.

Immutable images, secret references, replica/resource fields, recreation and authorized VM lifecycle actions are explicit deployment_configuration_code facts. Their presence does not require understanding later authentication or replica-scaling policies.

Deployment configuration's running-state walkthrough can be followed using prior readiness and prediction-contract instruction plus its own image-comparison facts; it does not depend on understanding the later release-verification concept.
Telemetry's complete probe denominator and handler instrumentation are taught within service_telemetry; sampled practice does not require later capacity-envelope, batching or scaling decisions.
Worker/resource inspection and replica-setting restoration are explicit facts of the current serving concepts, not dependencies on later resource-utilization or cleanup lessons.
Rollback uses supplied approval records and immutable replacement identity. It does not require understanding how later release-quality gates or pipeline promotion establish approval.
Up-next titles are passing previews and impose no requirement to understand the next concept.
summary: No BLOCKING or ADVISORY future-concept leakage found in the exhaustive text review or the nine sampled interactions. Unsampled interactions are not represented as reviewed.
